legend: Hello, my name is Steve. I invite you to the open olympiad at BSUIR. Take note of the coordinates: the star is called the Sun, and the planet is the third from the star. The olympiad will be attended by $$$n$$$ teams from the entire Milky Way galaxy, and your team will be the $$$n + 1$$$-th. Oh, and don't forget to come up with a problem, as this is an open olympiad and each team must propose exactly one problem. The olympiad will take place outdoors, and yes, for solving each problem your team will receive a balloon. But remember, during the olympiad it is forbidden to communicate with other participants and leave the olympiad area, otherwise the team will be disqualified. Let the strongest win, or rather the one who solves at least one more problem than all the other teams.

Steve has given you a certain list. This list contains information about each of the $$$n$$$ teams: $$$s_i$$$ — the strength of the $$$i$$$-th team, $$$w_i$$$ — the total weight of the $$$i$$$-th team, and $$$d_i$$$ — the difficulty of the problem proposed by the $$$i$$$-th team. According to the olympiad rules, for solving a problem of difficulty $$$x$$$, the team receives a balloon with a load capacity of $$$x$$$. Each team (including yours) always solves problems whose difficulty does not exceed the team's strength. The team always solves its own problem regardless of the difficulty. If at any moment the total load capacity of the balloons exceeds the weight of the team, it will take off into the air and leave the olympiad area, which in turn leads to disqualification.
You are wondering if you can win the olympiad by proposing a problem with a positive integer difficulty.
input: The first line contains three integers $$$n$$$, $$$s_0$$$, and $$$w_0$$$ — the number of teams, the strength, and the weight of your team, respectively.
The next $$$n$$$ lines each contain three integers $$$s_i$$$, $$$w_i$$$, and $$$d_i$$$ — the strength and weight of the $$$i$$$-th team, and difficulty of the problem proposed by the $$$i$$$-th team.
output: In a single line, output "Yes" if your team can win the olympiad. Otherwise, output "No".

legend.ai: 你好，我叫 Steve。我邀请你参加在 BSUIR 举办的公开赛。请记住坐标：这颗恒星名为 Sun，而这颗行星距离恒星第三远。届时将有来自整个银河系的 $$$n$$$ 支队伍参加，你的队伍将是第 $$$n + 1$$$ 支。哦，别忘了准备一道题，因为这是公开赛，每支队伍都必须恰好提出一道题。比赛将在户外举行，而且没错，你的队伍每解出一道题就会获得一个气球。但请记住，比赛期间禁止与其他参赛者交流，也不得离开比赛区域，否则队伍将被取消资格。让最强者获胜，或者更准确地说，让比其他所有队伍至少多解出一道题的队伍获胜。

Steve 给了你一个列表，其中包含有关 $$$n$$$ 支队伍的信息：$$$s_i$$$ 表示第 $$$i$$$ 支队伍的实力，$$$w_i$$$ 表示第 $$$i$$$ 支队伍的总重量，$$$d_i$$$ 表示第 $$$i$$$ 支队伍提出的问题的难度。根据奥林匹克竞赛规则，解出难度为 $$$x$$$ 的问题后，队伍会获得一个承重能力为 $$$x$$$ 的气球。每支队伍(包括你的队伍)都会解出所有难度不超过自身实力的问题。无论难度如何，每支队伍都会解出自己提出的问题。如果任何时刻气球的总承重能力超过队伍的重量，队伍就会乘气球飞上天空并离开竞赛区域，从而被取消资格。
你想知道，是否可以通过提出一道难度为正整数的题目来赢得奥林匹克竞赛。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 $$$n$$$、$$$s_0$$$ 和 $$$w_0$$$，分别表示队伍数量、你们队伍的实力和权重。
接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行每行包含三个整数 $$$s_i$$$、$$$w_i$$$ 和 $$$d_i$$$，分别表示第 $$$i$$$ 支队伍的实力和重量，以及第 $$$i$$$ 支队伍提出的问题的难度。

output.ai: 如果你的队伍能赢得奥林匹克竞赛，请在一行中输出 "Yes"；否则，输出 "No"。
